verses.text: Woe to those who devise iniquity and plot evil on their beds! At morning’s light they accomplish it because the power is in their hands.

xrefs.text: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.
The weapons of the scoundrel are destructive; he hatches plots to destroy the poor with lies, even when the plea of the needy is just.
Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
For they prepare their heart like an oven while they lie in wait; all night their anger smolders; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.
From you, O Nineveh, comes forth a plotter of evil against the LORD, a counselor of wickedness.

verses.text: They covet fields and seize them; they take away houses. They deprive a man of his home, a fellow man of his inheritance.

xrefs.text: Woe to you who add house to house and join field to field until no place is left and you live alone in the land.
Hear this, you who trample the needy, who do away with the poor of the land,
“But your eyes and heart are set on nothing except your own dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood, on practicing extortion and oppression.”
He oppresses the poor and needy; he commits robbery and does not restore a pledge. He lifts his eyes to idols; he commits abominations.
For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.

verses.text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “I am planning against this nation a disaster from which you cannot free your necks. Then you will not walk so proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.

xrefs.text: And wherever I have banished them, the remnant of this evil family will choose death over life,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
The proud look of man will be humbled, and the loftiness of men brought low; the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.
Therefore, the prudent keep silent in such times, for the days are evil.

Now therefore, tell the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem that this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I am planning a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways, and correct your ways and deeds.’
Therefore hear the word of the LORD, O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.

verses.text: In that day they will take up a proverb against you and taunt you with this bitter lamentation: ‘We are utterly ruined! He has changed the portion of my people. How He has removed it from me! He has allotted our fields to traitors.’”

xrefs.text: Will not all of these take up a taunt against him, speaking with mockery and derision: ‘Woe to him who amasses what is not his and makes himself rich with many loans! How long will this go on?’
The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered. For the LORD has spoken this word.

I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, a dirge over the wilderness pasture, for they have been scorched so no one passes through, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. Both the birds of the air and the beasts have fled; they have gone away.
Then I asked: “How long, O Lord?” And He replied: “Until the cities lie ruined and without inhabitant, until the houses are left unoccupied and the land is desolate and ravaged,
I will again bring a conqueror against you, O dweller of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

verses.text: Therefore, you will have no one in the assembly of the LORD to divide the land by lot.

xrefs.text: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when He divided the sons of man, He set the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.
Appoint three men from each tribe, and I will send them out to survey the land and map it out, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me
And Joshua cast lots for them in the presence of the LORD at Shiloh, where he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their divisions.
The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the LORD.
They will not remain in the land of the LORD; Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.

verses.text: “Do not preach,” they preach. “Do not preach these things; disgrace will not overtake us.”

xrefs.text: “But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.
They say to the seers, “Stop seeing visions!” and to the prophets, “Do not prophesy to us the truth! Speak to us pleasant words; prophesy illusions.
I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth, and you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, though they are a rebellious house.
At this, they yielded to Gamaliel. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and released them.
But to keep this message from spreading any further among the people, we must warn them not to speak to anyone in this name.

verses.text: Should it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the Spirit of the LORD impatient? Are these the things He does?” Do not My words bring good to him who walks uprightly?

xrefs.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words became my joy and my heart’s delight. For I bear Your name, O LORD God of Hosts.
He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,
So he said to me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.
If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.

verses.text: But of late My people have risen up like an enemy: You strip off the splendid robe from unsuspecting passersby like men returning from battle.

xrefs.text: I am among the peaceable and faithful in Israel, but you are trying to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. Why would you swallow up the LORD’s inheritance?”
Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh; together they turn against Judah. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.

So the LORD his God delivered Ahaz into the hand of the king of Aram, who attacked him and took many captives to Damascus. Ahaz was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with great force.

verses.text: You drive the women of My people from their pleasant homes. You take away My blessing from their children forever.

xrefs.text: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.
I will display My glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the judgment that I execute and the hand that I lay upon them.
And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, to send them far from their homeland.

verses.text: Arise and depart, for this is not your place of rest, because its defilement brings destruction— a grievous destruction!

xrefs.text: For you have not yet come to the resting place and the inheritance that the LORD your God is giving you.
They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
Therefore, while the promise of entering His rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be deemed to have fallen short of it.

In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and carried away the Israelites to Assyria, where he settled them in Halah, in Gozan by the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes.
You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.

verses.text: If a man of wind were to come and say falsely, “I will preach to you of wine and strong drink,” he would be just the preacher for this people!

xrefs.text: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority. My people love it so, but what will you do in the end?
For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.
They say to the seers, “Stop seeing visions!” and to the prophets, “Do not prophesy to us the truth! Speak to us pleasant words; prophesy illusions.
They keep saying to those who despise Me, ‘The LORD says that you will have peace,’ and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart, ‘No harm will come to you.’

“Indeed,” declares the LORD, “I am against those who prophesy false dreams and retell them to lead My people astray with their reckless lies. It was not I who sent them or commanded them, and they are of no benefit at all to these people,” declares the LORD.

verses.text: I will surely gather all of you, O Jacob; I will collect the remnant of Israel. I will bring them together like sheep in a pen, like a flock in the midst of its pasture— a noisy throng.

xrefs.text: “On that day,” declares the LORD, “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.
Then the people of Judah and of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint for themselves one leader, and will go up out of the land. For great will be the day of Jezreel.
Then the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for man or linger for mankind.

you are to tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will take the Israelites out of the nations to which they have gone, and I will gather them from all around and bring them into their own land.
For this is what the LORD says: “Sing with joy for Jacob; shout for the foremost of the nations! Make your praises heard, and say, ‘O LORD, save Your people, the remnant of Israel!’

verses.text: One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate, and go out by it. Their King will pass through before them, the LORD as their leader.

xrefs.text: For you will not leave in a hurry nor flee in haste, for the LORD goes before you, and the God of Israel is your rear guard.
This is what the LORD says to Cyrus His anointed, whose right hand I have grasped to subdue nations before him, to disarm kings, to open the doors before him, so that the gates will not be shut:
Then the LORD will appear over them, and His arrow will go forth like lightning. The Lord GOD will sound the ram’s horn and advance in the whirlwinds of the south.
My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
where Jesus our forerunner has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
